title: Career ID closure is not execution closure
claim: Career's 888/888 structured-ID census means every canonical ID has a traceable disposition; it does not mean all 888 rules are executable. The accepted backlog still records 513 BLOCKED_OUTCOME_MAPPING entries, while the separate 251-row contextual-activation closure reports 0 conditions compiled and 0 execution unlocks.
maturity_note: The counts are explicit in accepted main artifacts. The 888-rule and 251-row censuses have different denominators; 228/228 deep-source review refers to blocked rows in the latter and must not be conflated with the 513 outcome-mapping blockers.
wording_ceiling: Say 'Career IDs have disposition coverage, with substantial semantic/ontology blockers remaining'; do not say 888 executable rules or completed Career inference.
